---
title: "Trigger release publish"
description: "Starts the release as a separate workflow run."
---

`trigger-release-publish.yml` sends a `repository_dispatch` event of type
`release-publish` to your repository. A caller listening for it — the
publish file of the [release chain](release.qmd) — then runs the release as
a new, independent run. Why this detour is needed is explained there.

## Example

It is the last job of the release trigger:

```yaml
  trigger-release:
    needs: on-success
    if: needs.on-success.result == 'success'
    uses: FlorianSchw/package-workflows/.github/workflows/trigger-release-publish.yml@main
```

The receiving side:

```yaml
on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [release-publish]
```
